title: Protocol for investigating tertiary lymphoid structures in human and murine fixed tissue sections using Opal™-TSA multiplex immunohistochemistry
protocol: Obtain fresh human or murine tissue specimens in accordance with institutional ethical approval.
Store the specimen in a container with 1× PBS on ice prior to fixation.
Transfer the specimen into an embedding cassette labeled with a lead/graphite pencil using a sterile pipette tip.
Fix human tissue by submersion in a container with 10% NBF solution for 1–16 hours in a fume hood.
Fix murine tissue in a container with zinc-salt fixative overnight (16–18 hours) in a fume hood.
Dehydrate tissue using gradual ethanol immersions in pre-filled glass jars in a fume hood.
Immerse the specimen in 70% ethanol for 15 minutes.
Immerse the specimen in 90% ethanol for 15 minutes.
Immerse the specimen in 100% ethanol for 15 minutes.
Immerse the specimen in 100% ethanol for 30 minutes.
Immerse the specimen in 100% ethanol for 30 minutes.
Immerse the specimen in 100% ethanol for 30 minutes.
Displace Ethanol from tissue using gradual xylene immersions in pre-filled glass jars in a fume hood.
Immerse tissue in Xylene for 30 minutes.
Repeat immersion of tissue in Xylene for another 30 minutes.
Immerse tissue in Xylene for 60 minutes.
Infiltrate the tissue with paraffin using gradual paraffin wax immersions in pre-filled and warmed wax heater pots in a fume hood.
Immerse tissue in paraffin wax at 56°C for 1 hour.
Repeat immersion of tissue in paraffin wax at 56°C for another 1 hour.
Pre-warm a metal mold at 23°C in the warming tray of a wax-free thermal console.
Transfer warm mold using sterile warm forceps to the hot plate of a paraffin embedding center.
Fill the base of the mold with melted paraffin and let it settle.
Remove the specimen from the embedding cassette using sterile forceps and place it at the center of the mold.
Transfer the mold to the cold spot using forceps and position the specimen with the assistance of the magnifier and light.
Fill the mold with melted paraffin.
Place the labeled embedding cassette without a lid on top of the mold, base downwards, filling the cassette with wax if necessary to avoid trapped air bubbles between the mold and the cassette frame.
Place the mold/cassette assembly in the cryo console at 4°C overnight (16-18 hours).
Remove the set tissue block from the mold and store it at room temperature (15°C–25°C) or at 4°C until use.
Cut 4-micron sections from the tissue blocks using a rotary microtome with a new blade.
Place individual sections in pre-filled containers with distilled water.
Transfer sections onto blank pre-labeled SuperFrost Plus™ Adhesion slides by placing a slide diagonally underneath an individual section in the water and lifting it up to capture the section.
Melt sections onto slides by gently submerging each slide on an angle into a pre-filled water bath at 37°C.

Place FFPE human tissue slides on a slide rack and dry them in a 37°C incubator for 24 hours or formalin-free zinc salt-fixed murine tissue slides on a slide rack and dry them at room temperature (15°C–25°C) overnight (16-18 hours).
Store the dried slides in a slide box at room temperature until use.
Place sectioned FFPE human tissue slides on a slide rack and bake them in a 60°C oven for at least 1 hour or overnight (16-18 hours).
Transfer slides to vertical slide rack and deparaffinize tissue sections using Xylene immersions for 10 min each in a fume hood.
Wear P2 mask when working with Xylene.
Rehydrate tissue sections using ethanol immersions: 100% Ethanol for 5 min, another 100% Ethanol for 5 min, then 70% Ethanol for 5 min in a fume hood.
Rinse tissue sections in deionized water.
Block endogenous peroxidases by immersing tissue sections in 3% H2O2 for 5 min and rinse in deionized water.
Deparaffinize and rehydrate tissue sections.
Perform heat-induced epitope retrieval (HIER) on the slides.
Wash slides in 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker for 2 min intervals.
Place slides vertically in Hellendahl staining jars filled with AR6 buffer and microwave until boiling, then reduce power to microwave for 20 min.
Allow slides to equilibrate to room temperature (RT) for at least 20 min after microwaving.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker for 2 min intervals and rinse in deionized water.
Dry slides by flicking and carefully remove residual buffer using lint-free paper.
Create a humidity chamber in a light-protected staining tray (StainTray™ Black lid).
Lay slides flat side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Circle tissue with a hydrophobic barrier pen, leaving an adequate margin.
Let the barrier dry completely.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue and incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
While blocking, prepare a 1:10 dilution of the anti-CD21 antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide after incubation.
Add diluted anti-CD21 antibody to the entire tissue and incubate at 4°C overnight (16–18 h).
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue and incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 40 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
During this step, prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 520 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep on ice until use.
Add diluted Opal™ 520 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in deionized water.
Pre-fill jars with AR9 buffer, place slides vertically and add lids.
Unmask antigen epitopes by microwaving jars until the buffer begins to boil, then reduce power and microwave for 15 minutes.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to RT (15°C–25°C) for at least 20 minutes.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in deionized water.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
While blocking, prepare a 1:100 dilution of the anti-DC-LAMP antibody (final concentration: 10 μg/mL) in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-DC-LAMP antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT for 1 hour.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 20 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides thrice on an orbital shaker with pre-filled jars of 1× TBST at 2-minute intervals.
During washing, prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 540 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 540 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides thrice on an orbital shaker with pre-filled jars of 1× TBST at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Pre-fill jars with AR9 buffer, place slides vertically and add lids.
Unmask antigen epitopes by microwaving jars until the buffer begins to boil, then reduce power and microwave for 15 minutes at 20% power.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to RT (15°C–25°C) for at least 20 minutes.
Wash slides thrice on an orbital shaker with pre-filled jars of 1× TBST at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
While blocking, prepare a 1:1000 dilution of the anti-CD4 antibody (final concentration: 0.143 μg/mL) in Blocking/Antibody Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Remove blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-CD4 antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 1 h.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 20 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 570 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Add diluted Opal™ 570 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Pre-fill jars with AR9 buffer, place slides vertically and add lid.
Unmask antigen epitopes by microwaving jars at 100% power until the buffer begins to boil.
Reduce microwave power to 20%, continue microwaving for 15 min.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to RT (15°C–25°C) for at least 20 min.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Prepare a 1:100 dilution of the anti-PNAd antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent while blocking.
Keep the diluted anti-PNAd antibody on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-PNAd antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at 4°C overnight (16–18 h).
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 20 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 620 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent while washing.
Keep the diluted Opal™ 620 on ice until use.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 620 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Pre-fill jars with AR9 buffer.
Place slides vertically and add lid.
Unmask antigen epitopes by microwaving jars at 100% power until the buffer begins to boil, then reduce power to 20% and microwave for an additional 15 min.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to room temperature (RT) for at least 20 minutes.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in distilled water (dH2O).
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue, and incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
While blocking, prepare a 1:50 dilution of the anti-CD8 antibody (final concentration: 10 μg/mL) in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-CD8 antibody to the entire tissue, and incubate at RT for 1 hour.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue, and incubate at RT for 20 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
During this step, prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 650 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep on ice until use.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 650 to the entire tissue, and incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in distilled water (dH2O).
Pre-fill jars with AR9 buffer.
Place slides vertically and add lid.
Microwave jars at 100% power until the buffer begins to boil, then reduce power to 20% and continue for 15 minutes.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to room temperature (15°C–25°C) for at least 20 minutes.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Rinse slides in distilled water.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
While blocking, prepare a 1:300 dilution of the anti-CD19 antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide, add diluted anti-CD19 antibody to the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 1 hour.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Opal™ Polymer HRP Ms + Rb secondary antibody to the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 20 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
During this step, prepare a 1:100 dilution of Opal™ 690 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep on ice until use.
Add diluted Opal™ 690 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Pre-fill jars with AR6 buffer.
Place slides vertically and add lid.
Microwave jars at 100% power until the buffer begins to boil.
Reduce microwave power to 20% and continue microwaving for 15 min.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to RT (15°C–25°C) for at least 20 min.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Rinse slides in dH2O.
Wash slides in 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides by flicking and carefully remove residual buffer surrounding the tissue using lint-free paper.
Fill a light-protected staining tray (StainTray™ Black lid) to create a humidity chamber, and then lay slides flat side-by-side.
Block endogenous peroxidase by covering tissue with PeroxAbolish and incubate at RT for 30 min.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O once.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST twice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue and incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Prepare a 1:5000 dilution of anti-PNAd antibody in Blocking/Antibody Diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-PNAd antibody to the entire tissue and incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 1 h.
Pre-heat low pH glycine-based buffer on a 50°C orbital shaker.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Transfer slides to Hellendahl staining jars and wash thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add ImmPRESS® Polymer HRP anti-rat secondary antibody to the entire tissue and incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Prepare a 1:150 dilution of Opal™ 690 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent.
Keep diluted Opal™ 690 on ice until use.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 690 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Pre-fill jars with low pH glycine-based buffer.
Add slides vertically to the jars containing the buffer.
Elute bound antibodies by shaking at 50°C on an orbital shaker at 100 rpm for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O once.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST twice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of the anti-CD4 antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent.
Keep diluted anti-CD4 antibody on ice until use.
Remove blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-CD4 antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at 4°C overnight (16–18 hours).
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add ImmPRESS® Polymer HRP anti-rat secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Prepare a 1:150 dilution of Opal™ 620 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 620 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Pre-fill jars with low pH glycine-based buffer and then add slides vertically.
Elute bound antibodies by shaking at 50°C on an orbital shaker at 100 rpm for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O once, and in 1× TBST twice on an orbital shaker at 2-minute intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Prepare a 1:2000 dilution of the anti-CD8 antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Remove blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-CD8 antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add ImmPRESS® Polymer HRP anti-rat secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Prepare a 1:150 dilution of Opal™ 570 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Add diluted Opal™ 570 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Pre-fill jars with tris-EDTA buffer and add slides vertically.
Unmask antigen epitopes by microwaving jars with lids on at 100% power until the buffer begins to boil, then reduce power to 10% and microwave for 7.5 min.
Remove jar lids and allow slides to equilibrate to RT (15°C–25°C) for at least 15 min.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O once, and with 1× TBST twice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Dilute the anti-CD19 antibody at a ratio of 1:200 in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide, add diluted anti-CD19 antibody to cover the entire tissue, and incubate overnight (16–18 h) at 4°C.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST and wash them in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST three times on an orbital shaker for 2 minutes each.
Pre-heat the low pH glycine-based buffer on a 50°C orbital shaker.
Dry the slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add ImmPRESS® Polymer HRP anti-rabbit secondary antibody to cover the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST and wash them in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST three times on an orbital shaker for 2 minutes each.
Dilute Opal™ 650 at a ratio of 1:150 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep it on ice until use.
Dry the slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 650 to cover the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST and wash them in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST three times on an orbital shaker for 2 minutes each.
Pre-fill jars with low pH glycine-based buffer, add the slides vertically, and shake at 50°C on an orbital shaker at 100 rpm for 30 minutes to elute bound antibodies.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O once and with 1× TBST twice on an orbital shaker for 2 minutes each.
Add Blocking/Antibody Diluent to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Prepare a 1:1500 dilution of the anti-CD21 antibody in Blocking/Antibody diluent and keep on ice until use.
Remove the blocking buffer from each slide.
Add diluted anti-CD21 antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 1 h.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add ImmPRESS® Polymer HRP anti-rabbit secondary antibody to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Prepare a 1:150 dilution of Opal™ 540 in 1× Plus Amplification Diluent and keep on ice until use.
Dry slides and place these side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Add diluted Opal™ 540 to the entire tissue.
Incubate at RT (15°C–25°C) for 10 min.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST thrice on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Wash slides once with dH2O on an orbital shaker at 2 min intervals.
Dry slides and place them side-by-side in the humidity chamber.
Stain cell nuclei by adding 1 drop of DAPI per 500 μL of 1× TBST to the entire tissue, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Rinse slides in 1× TBST.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with 1× TBST for 2 minutes on an orbital shaker.
Wash slides in jars pre-filled with dH2O for 2 minutes on an orbital shaker.
Dry slides thoroughly.

Pipette 40 μL of VECTASHIELD Vibrance mounting medium onto FFPE slides or 10–15 μL of ProLong™ Diamond Antifade Mountant onto formalin-free zinc salt-fixed slides and apply coverslips, avoiding the formation of bubbles.
Create an individual protocol for each slide.
Set optimal exposure time settings across fluorescent filter cubes (DAPI, FITC, Cy3, Texas red, and Cy5).
Perform whole slide scans after loading all slides into a slide cassette.
View captured WSSs using Phenochart and select areas for MSI acquisition.
Proceed with automated imaging of selected areas.
Spectrally unmix all MSIs using custom spectral libraries on the inForm® Cell Analysis software.
Analyze unmixed MSIs to phenotype and quantify cell types of interest as per user requirements.
Export MSIs (multi-image TIFF) if analyzing them using the HALO® Image Analysis Platform.
